lines.text: Eight in the morning. The first order of the day comes in.
Orders arrived by phone, by walk-in, and by text, and every branch kept its own paper log.
Now every order, from every branch, lands in one queue.
At the counter, the cashier picks the branch, sees what's in stock, and places the order.
Every cylinder is counted, filled or empty, across all five branches.
And by evening, the owner pulls the sales report for any date range, without asking anyone.
New Zion LPG. Point of sale and CMS, built by Keith Vergara.
